dFdDummy_c is the no-op FaderColor variant embedded at +0x54 in dScDSMT_c: SetForwardTime/SetBackwardTime write the interp speed and virtual-call the inherited IsAtEnd/IsAtStart (slots 6/5), AdvanceFade is a tail-call veneer into the base chain's AdvanceInterp, and the destructor pair is emitted by the one ~dFdDummy_c() definition.

The whole class folds, lifecycle variants included: the cartridge's D0,D1 pair is the tail of the D2,D0,D1 variant group one ~dFdDummy_c() emits under deferred codegen (the emitted D2 sibling has no cartridge home and deadstrips unenrolled), and no C1/C2 exist to absorb -- the class is only ever embedded, built by the func_02017278 helper outside the range.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen; the emitted object carries the five functions ascending 0x020171c8..0x02017278.

Unlike the dExt* siblings (MaterialChanger, TextureTransformer), the cartridge already spells this class's RTTI records dFdDummy_c/dFdColor_c -- the configured _ZTS/_ZTI/_ZTV symbols match the emitted spellings, so the TU keeps RTTI on and the emitted records re-verify their canonical homes.
